title: adonis flammea var. citrina
intro: Adonis flammea var. citrina, commonly known as the yellow Adonis or yellow Adonis flower, is a plant species belonging to the genus Adonis, known for its vibrant yellow flowers and medicinal properties. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Adonis flammea var. citrina include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, which help to relieve pain, reduce inflammation, and calm muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
